tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel gyi sbyor ṭīka 'jig rten gsum sgron la 'jug pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man
༄༅/ /mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel gyi sbyor ṭīka 'jig rten gsum sgron la 'jug pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel gyi sbyor ṭīka 'jig rten gsum sgron la 'jug pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsa 'grel gyi sbyor ba'i ṭī ka 'jig rten gsum gyi sgron me la 'jug pa zhes bya ba/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// zab cing spros pa nyer zhi zhing*//'phags gsum smin byed rgyal ba kun//bskyed mdzad rten cing 'brel 'byung ba//rgyal yum khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//dam chos kun gyi 'byung gnas zas gtsang sras//de yi rgyal tshab dam pa mi pham mgon//thogs med dbyig gnyen seng ge bzang po sogs//brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gus phyag 'tshal//chos kun gzigs pa'i mkha' dbyings la bgrod de//snyan par grags pa'i 'od zer 'bum bkye bas//thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gos can gsal mdzad pa//rgyal ba'i dbang po nyi ma de la 'dud//gang gis mkhyen brtse'i lhun po rab bskyod nas//shes rab pha rol phyin mtsho bsrubs pa las//'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel sgron me'i mchog/legs bshad nyin mor byed pa 'di shar tshe//mi shes mun pa'i smag tshogs rgyang srings shing*//gsung rab 'dab brgya'i tshal rnams rab phye nas//blo gsal bung ba'i tshogs la dga' ston byin//de la 'jug cing nges don la gzhol ba'i//gzhung don sbyor ba'i ngag tu dril ba 'di//slob ma'i tshogs la phan phyir bri bar bya//de la 'dir rang cag ma rig pa'i mun pa bstug pos ha cang sbags pas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen por bying ba rnams la brtse ba chen pos 'don par dam bcas te/brtson pa'i stobs zla med pas bsgrubs pa gang bla na med cing mtshungs pa med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos mtha' yas pa rnams bskyed cing gso bar byed pa'i yum/ bde bar gshegs pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ legs par gsungs pa thams cad kyi rab dang phul dang gtso bo/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad ky-i thar pa'i lam gcig pu/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo thams cad kyi mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi bstan bcos 'grel pa dang bcas pa 'chad pa la gsum/ bstan bcos 'chad pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag /yan lag can gyi bstan bcos dngos/ bshad pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i yan lag mjug gi don no//dang po la gnyis/ lo tsā bas bstan bcos bsgyur ba'i yan lag tu mdzad pa dang*/ 'grel pa mdzad pa pos 'grel pa rtsom pa'i yan lag tu mdzad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ mtshan gyi don/ bam po'i grangs/ 'gyur gyi phyag go /dang po la gsum/ mtshan bsgyur ba/ bshad pa/ btags pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ rgya gar skad du/ a bhi sa ma ya a laṃ kā ra nā ma pradzñā pā ra mi tā u pa de sha shāst+ra bṛd ti/ bod skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa/'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka rgya gar gyi skad du bstan bcos 'di'i ming la ji skad zer snyam na/ yul de na skad rigs bzhi yod pa las legs sbyar gyi skad du/ 'di'i ming la/ a bhi sa ma ya/ zhes sogs zer la/ de bod kyi skad du bsgyur na/ pradzñā ni shes rab/ pā ra mi tā ni pha rol tu phyin pa/ u pa de sha ni man ngag /shāst+ra ni bstan bcos/ a bhi sa ma ya ni mngon par rtogs pa/ ā laṅkar ni rgyan/ nā ma ni zhes bya ba/ bṛtti ni 'grel pa zhes par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ( bshad pa ) ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni skabs 'dir gzhung sher phyin te/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la sogs pa'o//man ngag ni/ myur du khong du chud par byed pa ste/ mdo don rgya chen po tshig nyung ngus bde blag tu rtogs par byed pa'o//bstan bcos kyi sgra'i don ni/ 'chos skyob kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'o//mngon par rtogs pa ni/ yang dag pa'i don la mngon du phyogs pa dang don de ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa ste/

mngon rtogs brgyad do//rgyan ni/ gsal byed dang mdzes byed kyi rgyan gnyis ka'o/ /zhes bya ba ni/ bstan bcos 'di'i mtshan la de skad du 'don par bya'o zhes pa'i don no//'grel pa ni/ rnam par 'byed cing go gsal bar 'grel pa'o//gsum pa ( btags pa'i dgos pa ) la gsum/ rgya skad smos pa'i dgos pa/ bod skad smos pa'i dgos pa/ mtshan btags pa'i dgos pa dngos so/ /dang po ni/ chos khungs btsun par ston pa dang*/ skad la bag chags 'jog pa/ rgyud la byin brlabs 'jug pa'i ched do//gnyis pa ( bod skad smos pa'i dgos pa ) ni/ rgya bod kyi skad gnyis kyis don gcig brjod pas na de gnyis rnam grangs su shes pa'i ched dang*/ de gnyis drang thad dang thad log tu 'byung ba don mi 'chug par bsgyur bas na lo paṇa mkhas grub tu shes pa'i ched dang*/ rgya skad go dka' ba bod skad go sla bar bsgyur bas sgyur byed kyi drin dran pa'i ched du'o//gsum pa ( mtshan btags pa'i dgos pa dngos ) la/ spyir ming btags pa'i dgos pa dang*/ bye brag tu klad du smos pa'i dgos pa gnyis te/ dang po ni/ ming de las ming don 'brel bar shes pas na ming la brten nas don rtogs par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod de/ ji skad du/ ming du gdags par ma mdzad na//'jig rten thams cad rmongs par 'gyur//de bas rmongs pa spang ba'i phyir//mgon pos ming du gdags par mdzad//ces pa ltar ro//gnyis pa ( bye brag tu klad du smos pa'i dgos pa ) ni/ glegs bam btsal sla ba'i ched du'o/ /gnyis pa bam po'i grangs ni/ 'grel pa/ bam po dang po/'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka bam po zhes pa bam tshad du longs pa'i gzhung gi cha mang po phyogs gcig tu sdoms nas gzhung tshan pa tshan par bsdams pa'i ming ste/ dper na rtsā'i bam po bzhin no//de'ang shloka stong gi sum cha la bam por byas pa dang shloka gsum brgya la bam por byas pa gnyis las/

'dir phyi ma ste/ shloka stong lnga brgya la bam po lngar byas pas so// dang po zhes pa ni/ bam grangs lnga yod pa'i dang po 'di nas 'chad pa'o//gsum pa 'gyur gyi phyag ni/ rtsa ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo//rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyis 'gyur mdzad pa'i thog mar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la gus pas phyag 'tshal ba chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ 'gyur mthar phyin pa'i ched yod pas so//gnyis pa 'grel pa mdzad pa pos 'grel pa rtsom pa'i yan lag tu mdzad pa la lnga/ mchod par brjod cing dbye bar dam bca' ba/ slob dpon snga mas phye ba'i tshul/ 'ga' zhig gis ma rnyed pa rnyed par bstan pa/ rnyed pa'i rgyu bstan pa/ khengs bskyung ba'o/ /dang po ni/'grel pa/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la//de'i rgyan tshig le'ur byas pa dag/kun gyi rgyan du 'gyur bar ni//rnam par dbye phyir gus phyag 'tshal// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka slob dpon seng ge bzang pos 'grel pa rtsom pa'i thog mar gzhung shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brjod bya dang bcas pa la gus phyag 'tshal ba chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ sher phyin de'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa mngon rtogs rgyan dag yum gsum po kun gyi rgyan du 'gyur bar ni rnam par dbye bar bya ba'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ ngag don/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po chos can/ 'grel pa rtsom pa'i thog mar yum la phyag 'tshal ba la dgos pa yod de/ mngon rtogs rgyan yum gsum po kun gyi rgyan du bsgrub pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ( slob dpon snga mas phye ba'i tshul ) la bzhi/ thogs med kyis rnam bshad mdzad tshul/ dbyig gnyen gyis bkrol tshul/ 'phags grol gyis phye tshul/ btsun grol gyis rnam bshad byas tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ 'gro la chags pas kun chags mdzad//'phags pa thogs med skyob nyid kyis//mi pham mgon la gsan nas ni//bstan bcos chen po'i rnam bshad mdzad//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka

'gro ba la snying rje'i chags pas kun tu chags par mdzad pa'i 'phags pa thogs med skyob pa nyid chos can/ khyod kyis bstan bcos chen po mngon rtogs rgyan mdo dang bcas pa'i rnam bshad mdzad de/ mi pham mgon po la chos dngos su gsan pa la brten nas ni de nyid rnam nges mdzad pa'i phyir/ ngag don/ 'phags pa thogs med chos can/ bstan bcos chen po'i rnam bshad mdzad de/ de nyid rnam nges mdzad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ( dbyig gnyen gyis bkrol tshul ) ni/ 'grel pa/ 'gro don rtsa lag dbyig gi gnyen//rang gi mos pa gtsor byed pas//shes bya nang gi yin pa la//yang dag brten nas rnam par bkrol//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka 'gro ba'i don phan bde'i rtsa lag dbyig gi gnyen chos can/ de rnam par bkrol te/ rang sems tsam gyi lta ba la mos pa gtso bor byed pa'i dbang gis shes bya yul du snang ba rnams nang sems kyi bdag nyid yin par 'dod pa rnam rig gi grub mtha' la yang dag par brten nas ni nyi khri gzhung 'grel mdzad pas so//gsum pa ( 'phags grol gyis phye tshul ) ni/ 'grel pa/ 'phags pa'i khongs su gtogs pa yi//rnam par grol ba zhes byas kyang*//des byas byas pa min mthong nas//dbu mar gnas pa'i blos rnam phye// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka theg chen 'phags pa'i khongs su gtogs pa yi rnam par grol ba'i sde zhes bya bas kyang chos can/ de rnam par phye ste/ dbyig gnyen des sems tsam gyi grub mtha' dang mthun pa'i 'grel pa byas pa de yum don ji lta ba bzhin byas pa ma yin par mthong nas dgongs pa dbu mar gnas par rtogs pa'i blos nyi khri snang ba mdzad pas so//bzhi pa ( btsun grol gyis rnam bshad byas tshul ) ni/ 'grel pa/ de yi 'og tu rnam grol sde//dad pa'i sa la gnas pa yis//bstan bcos mtha' dag ma rnyed par//rang dang rjes mthun rnam bshad byas//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka 'phags grol gyis phye ba de'i 'og tu dad pa'i sa tshogs lam la gnas pa'i btsun pa rnam grol sde chos can/

khyod kyis de'i rnam bshad byas te/ bstan bcos 'di yum gsum po mtha' dag gi rgyan du ma rnyed par nyi khri le mang kho na'i don du rang gis rnyed pa dang rjes su mthun par nyi khri rnam 'grel mdzad pas so//gsum pa 'ga' zhig gis ma rnyed pa rnyed par bstan pa ni/ 'grel pa/ de ltar mkhas pas snang byas shing*//'ga' zhig kho nas ma rnyed pa'i//bstan bcos mtha' dag 'di de ltar//rnyed pa gang de ya mtshan no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka slob dpon seng ge bzang po chos can/ dbyig gnyen sogs 'ga' zhig kho nas ma rnyed pa'i bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan gyi tshig dang don mtha' dag 'di yum gsum car gyi tshig don gyi rgyan yin pa de ltar du rnyed pa gang yin pa de ni ya mtshan che ste/ bshad pa de ltar mkhas pa snga ma'i legs bshad kyis snang bar byas shing sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje dang rang gi blo gros kyi stobs kyis rnyed pas so//bzhi pa rnyed pa'i rgyu bstan pa ni/ 'grel pa/ de ltas shin tu rnyed dka' ba//zab mo'i lam 'di ci zhig ltar//sangs rgyas dbang gis rnyed pa ni//mkhas pa rnams kyis dbye ba'i rigs// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka de lta bas na slob dpon seng ge bzang po chos can/ shin tu rnyed dka' ba'i zab mo'i lam sher phyin gyi tshig don 'di ni rnyed pa'i rgyu yod de/ yun ring por rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes par byas pas dus ci zhig ltar na/ sangs rgyas kyi byin brlabs kyi dbang gis rnyed pas so//des na/ sher phyin de dag rnam par dbye bar rigs te/ rnyed dka' ba rnyed pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis de la srid zhu byed dgos pas so//lnga pa khengs pa bskyung ba ni/ 'grel pa/ rnam pa kun tu bdag gi ni//spyod yul min yang bsod nams dag/bsgrub dang mthun phyir rang gzhan la//phan gdags 'dod pas spro ba skyes//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka de chos can/ yum don rnam pa kun tu seng bzang bdag gi ni mngon sum gyi spyod yul min yang 'grel pa rtsom pa la spro ba skyes te/

bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis po dag bsgrub pa dang rgyan gyi 'grel pa rtsom pa gnyis sangs rgyas kyi rgyur rjes su mthun par mthong nas rang gzhan la phan gdags par 'dod pa'i mkhas mchog yin pas so// gnyis pa yan lag can gyi bstan bcos dngos la gsum/ rang nyid bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag tu mchod brjod/ brtsams pa'i bstan bcos la gzhan 'jug pa'i yan lag tu dgos 'brel/ 'jug bya bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs nyid bshad pa'o//dang po la gsum/ mtshams sbyar ba/ rtsa ba/ 'grel pa'o/ /dang po ( mtshams sbyar ) ni/ 'grel pa/ 'phags pa byams pa rang nyid dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun par rab tu ston pas/ /so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yul can gyi rab tu dang ba ni legs pa thams cad 'thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin no zhes bya bar nges par bzung nas/ gzhan dag bcom ldan 'das ma yon tan rin po che phul du dbyung du med cing*/ dpag tu med pa'i 'byung gnas la don gyis 'jug par bya ba'i phyir rab tu dang ba bskyed pa'i ched du/ re zhig dang por yum la yon tan ji lta ba bzhin du brjod pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyi phyag 'tshal ba/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka 'phags pa byams pas re zhig bstan bcos rtsom pa'i dang por yum la spangs rtogs mdzad pa'i yon tan ji ltar yod pa bzhin du brjod pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ rang nyid gzhan ngor skyes bu dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun par rab tu ston pa'i ched dang*/ gdul bya gzhan dag bcom ldan 'das ma yon tan rin po che phul du dbyung du med cing dpag tu med pa'i 'byung gnas de la don gyis 'jug par bya ba'i phyir du rab tu dang ba bskyed pa'i ched du yin pas so//gdul bya yum la dang ba la brten nas de la don gyis 'jug par 'gyur bar cis shes she na/

byams pa'i mnyam gzhag so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes kyis shes te/ ye shes des yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mkhyen pa gsum gyi bdag nyid de dang ba'i mos yul du byed pa can gyi rab tu dang ba ni nges par leḍa pa byang chub gsum po thams cad 'thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin no zhes bya bar nges par gzung ba la brten nas so//ngag don/ rje btsun byams mgon chos can/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i thog mar mchod brjod mdzad pa la dgos pa yod de/ rang nyid gzhan ngor dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun par ston zhing gdul bya yum la dang ba bskyed pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ( rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams kun shes nyid kyis nyer zhir 'khrid mdzad gang yin dang*//'gro la phan par byed rnams lam shes nyid kyis 'jig rten don sgrub mdzad pa gang*//gang dang yang dag ldan pas thub rnams rnam pa kun ldan sna tshogs 'di gsungs pa//nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i tshoḍa bcas sangs rgyas kyi ni yum de la phyag 'tshal//1 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka rje btsun byams mgon chos can/ sangs rgyas nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pas bskor ba yi ni yum sher phyin de la phyag 'tshal bar rigs te/ yum kun shes nyid ky-is sras nyan thos dang rang rgyal sdug bsngal zhi ba'i myang 'das tshol ba rnams kyi bzhed don lhag bcas lhag med kyi nyer zhi gnyis su 'khrid par mdzad pa gang yin pa dang*/ yum lam shes nyid kyis sras 'gro ba la phan par byed pa'i byang sems rnams kyi bzhed don 'jig rten gyi don bsgrub par mdzad pa gang yin pa dang*/ yum rnam mkhyen gang dang yang dag par ldan pas sras thub pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi bzhed don chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa kun ldan sna tshogs pa 'di gsungs pa'i bdag rkyen mdzad pas so//ngag don/ de chos can/ yum mkhyen gsum la phyag 'tshal ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/
yum mkhyen pa gsum po des sras bzhi'i bzhed don mtha' dag rdzogs par sgrub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis phyag 'tshal ba'i phyir/ gsum pa

( 'grel pa ) la lnga/ snga 'grel gyi bsdus don la 'phros pa/ dgos don la 'phros pa/ mkhyen gsum la bstod pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rtsa ba'i tshig don/ rgal lan gyis gtan la phab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni 'di'i che ba'i bdag nyid phul du byung ba dang ldan pa brjod de/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka nyan thos zhi tshol gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni chos can/ yum la bstod de/ mkhyen gsum 'di'i che ba'i bdag nyid spangs rtogs mdzad pa'i yon tan gzhan las phul du byung ba dang ldan par brjod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ( dgos don la 'phros pa ) la gsum/ gnas skabs kyi dgos pa/ brgyud pa'i dgos pa/ mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dbang rtul dang ba bskyed pa'i dgos pa dang*/ dbang rnon dang ba bskyed pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/'grel pa/ de thos nas re zhig dad pa'-i rjes su 'brang ba rnams ni 'di la the tshom med par myur du rab tu dang ba skye'o//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka gdul bya de la gnyis yod pa las re zhig dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams ni chos can/ mchod yum 'di la the tshom med par dus myur du rab tu dang ba skye ba'i rgyu yod de/ nyan thos zhi tshol gyi tshigs bcad de thos pas rkyen byas nas dang bas so//gnyis pa ( dbang rnon dang ba bskyed pa'i dgos pa ) ni/ 'grel pa/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyang gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'i phyir/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'-i tshad mas gzhi dang lam dang rnam pa skye ba med par yongs su shes pa tshigs su bcad pa'i don gyi mtshan nyid kyi yum la gnod pa ma mthong nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid tshul gsum pa can/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa bskrun par mdzad pa ni gdon mi za bar srid pa nyid do/ /zhes nges par bzung ste/ de la rab tu dang ba skyed par byed pa nyid do//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka

gdul bya chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyang chos can/ yum de la rab tu dang ba skyed par byed pa nyid kyi rgyu yod de/ nyan thos zhi tshol sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i brjod bya'i don gyi mtshan nyid can gyi yum gzhi dang lam dang rnam pa skye ba med pa yongs su shes pa des sras bzhi'i bzhed don bsgrub pa'i tshul la gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'i phyir zhes bya ba la sogs pa skye med sgrub byed kyi rigs pa dang des drangs pa'i tshad mas gnod pa ma mthong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis so//de chos can/ yum la dang ba skye ba'i tshul yod de/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid theg pa gsum gyi tshul gsum pa can des sangs rgyas la sogs pa sras bzhi'i bzhed don mtha' dag bskrun par mdzad pa ni gdon mi za bar srid pa nyid do zhes nges par gzung ba'i tshul gyis dang ba skyes pas so//rab tu dang ba zhes pa dbang po rno rtul gnyis ka la 'byung yang de gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ snga ma the tshom med par myur du dang ba chen po skyes pa'i don dang*/ phyi ma brtags shing dpyad nas rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pa'i dang ba chen po skye ba'i don no//'di la dang*/ de la zhes pa ni dang ba skye dka' sla'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /yum gyi gdul bya dbang rnon chos can/ de la dang ba'i rgyu yod de/ des sras bzhi'i bzhed don bsgrub pa la gnod byed ma mthong zhing sgrub byed gzung ba'i gdul bya yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa brgyud pa'i dgos pa ni/ 'grel pa/ de la rab tu dang bas kyang de'i yon tan mngon par 'dod pa'i gang zag gnyis ka yang de dang de la brten pa'i gsung rab la rnam pa thams cad du gzung ba la sogs pa'i don du shin tu gus par byed do/ /de nas thos pa las byung ba la sogs pa'i shes pa skye ba'i rim gyis legs pa'i mchog 'thob par 'gyur ro//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka

gdul bya yum de la rab tu dang bas kyang chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ yum de'i spangs rtogs mdzad pa'i yon tan mngon par 'dod pa'i gang zag dbang po rno rtul gnyis ka'ang yum de dang de la brten pa'i gsung rab la rnam pa thams cad du tshig gzung ba dang kun chub par byed pa la sogs pa'i don du shin tu gus par byed pa'i phyir/ gus pa'i rjes de nas yum la thos pa las byung ba la sogs pa'i shes pa skye ba'i rim gyis zhugs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ nges par legs pa'i mchog bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur bas so//gsum pa ( mjug bsdu ba ) ni/ 'grel pa/ de'i phyir bcom ldan 'das ma la rab tu dang ba ni legs pa thams cad 'thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka bcom ldan 'das ma yum la rab tu dang ba ni chos can/ nges par legs pa byang chub thams cad 'thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin te/ nges legs kyi thog ma'i byed rgyu yin pa de'i phyir/ nyer len gyi rgyu dang thog ma'i byed rgyu gnyis ka rgyu'i gtso bo yin pa las 'dir phyi ma la dgongs te gsungs pa yin no//gsum pa mkhyen gsum la bstod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'grel pa/ de la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis ni don brgyad bsdus la de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin zhing*/ des kyang 'chad par 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis don thams cad phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /zhes de ltar thugs la bzhag nas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi sgo nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bstod do// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka snga 'grel du yum la yon tan brjod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas bstod par khas blangs pa la/ kha cig na re/ de ltar na bstod yul grangs mang ba'am nyung pa'i skyon du 'gyur te/ yum ni dngos po brgyad kyi rang bzhin yin la/ 'dir mkhyen gsum kho na'i sgo nas bstod pas so zhe na/

skyon med de/ mkhyen gsum gyi sgo nas bstod pas brgyad ka la bstod par 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ gcig la bstod pas mi chog par gsum la bstod pa la dgos pa yod par gzigs pas so// dang po ni/ byams mgon chos can/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bstod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bstod tshig gi ngag de la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis ni don mngon par rtogs pa brgyad bsdus la/ bsdu bya brgyad po de dag kyang lam dang 'bras bu'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'khor bcas kyi dbye ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so//gnyis pa ni/ de chos can/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum ka'i sgo nas yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bstod pa la dgos pa yod de/ mkhyen gsum des kyang tshig don gyi skabs nas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis sras bzhi'i bzhed don thams cad phun sum tshogs par sgrub nus pa yin no zhes de ltar thugs la bzhag nas bstod par shes pa'i ched yin pas so//de yang rnam mkhyen dang chos sku ni byang sems dang nyan rang gi dngos yum ma yin la/ lam shes dang sbyor bzhi ni nyan rang dang sangs rgyas kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos yum ma yin zhing*/ gzhi shes ni byang sems dang sangs rgyas kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos yum ma yin pa'i phyir/ de re re'i sgo nas bstod pas sras bzhi ka'i bzhed don phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub par mi rtogs pas sher phyin gyi yon tan mtha' dag brjod par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gsum ka la bstod dgos so zhes pa'i don yin no//ngag don/ de chos can/ mkhyen gsum gyi sgo nas yum la bstod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mkhyen gsum gyis dngos brgyad bsdus la/ bsdu bya de dag kyang bstod yul yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa rtsa ba'i tshig don bshad pa la gnyis/

mkhyen gsum gyis sras bzhi'i bzhed don so sor sgrub tshul dang*/ don bsdus te phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ gzhi shes kyis nyan rang gi dang*/ lam shes kyis byang sems kyi dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyis sangs rgyas kyi bzhed don sgrub tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ nyan thos dang de'i phyogs su bslan pa rnam par thar pa cung zad tsam zhig gis lhag pa rim pa gcig gis bstan pa rang sangs rgyas kyang ste/ mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod pa rnams/ gzhi thams cad skye ba med par yongs su shes pa nyid kyis phung po dang bcas pa dang*/ phung po med pa'i mtshan nyid kyis mya ngan las 'das pa rnam pa gnyis thob par mdzad pa gang yin pa dang*/'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka gzhi thams cad gang zag gi bdag dang gzung ba chos kyi rang bzhin gyis skye ba med par yongs su shes pa'i gzhi shes nyid gang yin pa chos can/ khyod kyis rang gi sras nyan thos dang nyan thos de'i phyogs su bslan nas/ nyan thos zhes pa'i tshig rim pa gcig gis bstan pa nyan thos las gzung med rtogs pa sogs rnam par thar pa cung zad tsam zhig gis lhag pa rang sangs rgyas kyang ste mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod pa rnams kyi bzhed don sgrub par mdzad de/ de dag gi bzhed don gyi gtso bo phung po lhag ma dang bcas pa dang*/ phung po lhag ma med pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi dman pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa rnam pa gnyis po 'thob par mdzad pas so//gnyis pa ( lam shes kyis byang sems kyi bzhed don sgrub tshul ) ni/ 'grel pa/ byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba ji srid par 'gro ba'i don byed pa rnams lam thams cad skye ba med par rtogs pa'-i ngo bo nyid kyis 'gro ba mtha' dag gi don sgrub par mdzad pa gang yin pa dang*/'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka lam gsum po thams cad bden pa'i skye ba med par rtogs pa'i ngo bo nyid yum lam shes gang yin pa chos can/ khyod kyis rang sras byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs par 'gro ba'i don byed par bzhugs pa rnams kyi bzhed don sgrub par mdzad de/

de'i bzhed don 'gro ba mtha' dag gi mngon mtho nges legs kyi don thams cad sgrub par mdzad pas so//gsum pa ( rnam mkhyen gyis sangs rgyas kyi bzhed don sgrub tshul ) ni/ 'grel pa/ rnam pa thams cad skye ba med par thugs su chud pa gang dang ldan na/ sangs rgyas yang dag par bsdams pa'i sku can/ rnal 'byor can gyi dbang phyug gi gtso bo rnams/ spyod pa'i gnyen por chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa rnam pa thams cad bskor bar mdzad pa/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka rgyu 'bras ngo bo'i rnam pa thams cad bden pa'i skye ba med par thugs su chud pa'i yon tan gang dang ldan pa'i yum rnam mkhyen chos can/ rang gi sras sangs rgyas sgo gsum nyes spyod las yang dag par bsdams pa'i sku can mngon par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor can gyi dbang phyug 'phags pa 'og ma rnams kyi gtso bo thub pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi bzhed don sgrub par mdzad de/ de rnams kyi bzhed don gyi gtso bo gdul bya nyon mongs la spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por rjod byed chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa brjod bya rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa 'di bskor ba'i bdag rkyen mdzad pa'i phyir/ ngag don/ byams mgon chos can/ rnam mkhyen la bstod de/ rnam mkhyen gyis sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub pa'i yon tan brjod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa don bsdus te phyag 'tshal ba ni/'grel pa/ sangs rgyas nyan thos la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba de sgrub par byed pa nyid kyi yum de la phyag 'tshal lo//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka byams mgon chos can/ yum mkhyen pa gsum po de la phyag 'tshal bar mdzad de/ sras kyi gtso bo sangs rgyas 'khor nyan thos la sogs pas rang rgyal byang sems rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba ste bzhi po de'i bzhed don sgrub par byed pa nyid kyi sgo nas yum la sgo gsum 'dud par mdzad pas so//lnga pa rgal lan gyis gtan la phab pa la gnyis/

brgal ba dang*/ lan no/ /dang po la/ yul gang la/ gang zag gang gis/ tshul ji ltar du brgal ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ mchod brjod kyi skabs su mkhyen gsum la phyag 'tshal ba'i shugs la mngon rtogs rgyan rtsom par dam bca' mdzad pa la yin te/ ji skad du/ nyi snang las/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi dbang du byas nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo zhes brjod pa 'dis ni de'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi man ngag 'di bshad sbyar du bya'o snyam pas rnam par bkrol bar bya'o zhes mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi bshad pa 'di sbyar bar dam bcas pa yin no/ /zhes 'byung bas so//gnyis pa ( gang zag gang gis brgal ba ) ni/ rgyan gyis gzhi gnyen rnam pa'i phyogs gsum ka brjod byar bsdus par mi shes pa'i blo dman pa 'ga' zhig gis brgal/ gsum pa ( tshul ji ltar du brgal ba ) ni/ 'grel pa/ de ltar phyag 'tshal ba dang bstod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gzhi dang gnyen po dang rnam pa rnams las gang yang rung ba zhig bsdus pa mdzad na/ phyogs dang po ltar na ni 'bad pa don med pa yin te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las ni mtshan nyid kyi bstan bcos dag las mi smos pa'i gzhi gang yin pa de 'byung ba ni med do//gnyis pa ltar na yang rnam par byang ba'i dngos po bsdus pa'i phyir kun nas nyon mongs pa'i dngos po ma bsdus pas 'di gang gi gnyen po yin pa khong du chud par mi 'gyur ro//gsum pa ltar na yang rnam pa gzhi med pa tsam zhig bsdus pa'i phyir/ don rtogs pa med pas/ cung zad kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir don med pa yin no snyam du gzhan dag sems par 'gyur ba ma yin nam zhe na/'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka de ltar yum la phyag 'tshal ba dang yon tan brjod pas bstod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan mdzad par dam 'cha' na/

gzhi dang*/ gnyen po dang*/ rnam pa rnams las gang yang rung ba zhig brjod byar bsdus pa mdzad dgos na/ gzhi kho na brjod byar ston nam/ gnyen po kho na brjod byar ston nam/ rnam pa kho na brjod byar ston/ phyogs dang po gzhi kho na ston pa ltar na ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan rtsom pa'i 'bad pa don med pa yin te/ chos mngon pa dang zlos par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mngon rtogs rgyan 'di las ni mtshan nyid kyi bstan bcos mngon pa dag las mi smos pa'i gzhi gang yin pa de brjod byar 'byung ba ni med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gnyen po tsam ston pa ltar na'ang*/ 'di brtsams pa la don med de/ rgyan la brten nas gnyen po 'di spang bya gang gi gnyen po yin pa khong du chud par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ rgyan 'dis gnyen po rnam par byang ba'i dngos po tsam zhig brjod byar bsdus pa'i phyir na/ spang bya kun nas nyon mongs pa'i dngos po cung zad kyang brjod byar ma bsdus pas so//gsum pa rnam pa tsam ston pa ltar na'ang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ khyod la brten nas mngon mtho nges legs kyi don rtogs pa med par thal/ khyod kyis rnam pa gzhi med pa tsam zhig brjod byar bsdus pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ thar pa don gnyer gyi skyes bu la nye bar mkho ba cung zad kyang ma bshad par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod brtsams pa la don med pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ kha cig /rnam pa gzhi bcas dang gzhi med brtag par byed de/ de ni spros pa la dga' ba rnams kyi ngor 'grel chen las gsungs pa ltar bkod kyi/ 'grel chung 'dir ni de bas cung zad bsdus pa'i tshul du gsungs so/ /de'i phyir/ spros pa la dga' na ni gnyen po la'ang spang bya dang bcas ma bcas brtag par bya bar rigs so/ /gong du bshad pa de bas na/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan brtsams pa la don med pa yin no snyam du rgol ba gzhan dag sems par 'gyur ba ma yin nam zhe na/

gnyis pa lan la bzhi/ lan dngos/ shes byed kyi khungs dgod pa/ bsdu byed gsum po ngos bzung ba/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ de ni ma yin te/ gang gi phyir nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi go rim ji lta ba bzhin thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag bsdus pas na/ phyogs gsum car gyis kyang bsdus pa'i phyir ro// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ gzhi gnyen rnam gsum gang rung re re kho na brjod byar bsdus pa la brjod pa'i skyon de ni yod pa ma yin te/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na/ khyod kyis gzhi gnyen rnam pa'i phyogs gsum car brjod byar bsdus shing*/ de gsum gyis kyang mkhyen gsum bsdus pa'i phyir te/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis go rims ji lta ba bzhin du nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas te sras bzhi po rnams kyi mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag bsdus pas na'o//gnyis pa

( shes byed kyi khungs dgod pa ) la gsum/ yum bar ma dang*/ bsdus pa dang*/ rgyas pa'i khungs dgod pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ bsdus tshul mdor bstan pa/ bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ 'di ltar rgyal ba'i yum bar ma las/ rab 'byor thams cad shes pa nyid ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin no/ /lam shes pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yin no/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yin no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka mkhyen gsum gyis sras bzhi'i mngon rtogs bsdus te/ rgyu mtshan 'di ltar/ rgyal ba'i yum bar ma nyi khri las/ rab 'byor thams cad shes pa nyid kyis ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon rtogs bsdus pa yin no/ /lam shes pa nyid kyis ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mngon rtogs bsdus pa yin no/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon rtogs bsdus pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ( bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan rgyas par bshad pa ) la gsum/ gzhi shes kyis nyan rang gi /lam shes kyis byang sems kyi/ rnam mkhyen gyis sangs rgyas kyi mngon rtogs bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po la gnyis/ rgyu mtshan dri ba dang*/ lan gyi sgo nas rgyu mtshan bkod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du thams cad 'tshal ba nyid nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi lags/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das shes bos nas/ rgyu mtshan ci'i slad du thams cad 'tshal ba ste shes pa nyid kyis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas 'phags pa rnams kyi mngon rtogs bsdus pa lags shes dris pa'o//gnyis pa ( lan gyi sgo nas rgyu mtshan bkod pa ) ni/ 'grel pa/

rab 'byor thams cad ni phyi dang nang gi chos rnams ji snyed pa 'di tsam yin la/ de dag kyang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis shes kyi lam thams cad kyis kyang ma yin la rnam pa thams cad du yang ma yin pas de'i phyir nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni thams cad shes pa nyid ces bya'o//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka de'i lan du bcom ldan 'das kyis rab 'byor zhes bos te/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas 'phags pa rnams kyi mngon rtogs ni thams cad shes pa nyid kyis bsdus shes bya ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan thams cad shes pa zhes pa'i shes rgyu thams cad de ni phyi dang nang gi skye mched kyis bsdus pa gzhi phung khams sogs kyi chos rnams ji snyed pa 'di tsam yin la/ gzhi de dag kyang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis gang zag dang gzung ba chos kyi bdag med par shes kyi lam gsum po thams cad kyi rtogs ris rgyud la bskyed cing shes pa'i tshul gyis kyang ma yin la/ rgyu 'bras ngo bo'i rnam pa thams cad mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i tshul gyis kyang ma yin pas de'i phyir/gnyis pa lam shes la'ang sngar ltar gnyis las/ dang po ( rgyu mtshan dri ba ) ni/ 'grel pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du lam gyi rnam pa 'tshal ba nyid byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lags/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka bcom ldan 'das rgyu mtshan ci'i slad du lam gsum gyi rnam pa rang bzhin med par 'tshal ba'i lam shes pa nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnams kyi mngon rtogs bsdus pa lags shes dris pa'o//gnyis pa ( lan gyi sgo nas rgyu mtshan bkod pa ) ni/ 'grel pa/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni nyan thos kyi lam gang yin pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa'i lam thams cad bskyed par bya zhing lam thams cad shes par bya'o//de dag kyang yongs su rdzogs par bya zhing de dag gi lam gyi bya ba yang bya la/

smon lam yongs su rdzogs par ma byas pa dang sems can rnams yongs su smin par ma byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su ma sbyang par de dag gi yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du ni mi bya'o/ /de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ces bya'o//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka rab 'byor shes bos nas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnams kyi mngon rtogs ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis bsdus shes bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnams kyis ni gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i nyan thos kyi lam gang yin pa dang gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa dang 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa'i lam gsum po'i rtogs ris thams cad rang rgyud la bskyed par bya zhing lam de thams cad shes par bya'o//lam gsum po de dag gi spangs rtogs kyang yongs su rdzogs par bya zhing*/ byang sems kyi 'phags lam de dag gis lam gyi bya ba mnyam gzhag tu sgrib pa spong ba dang*/ rjes thob tu yon tan bsgrub pa'ang bya ba'i shes rab khyad par can dang ldan la/ smon lam yongs su rdzogs par ma byas pa dang*/ sems can rnams yongs su smin par ma byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su ma sbyangs par byang sems de dag gis yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du ni mi bya ba'i thabs mkhas khyad par can dang ldan pa de'i phyir ro//ngag don/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes chos can/ lam shes yin te/ shes bya lam gsum la shes bskyed rdzogs gsum byed pa'i shes rab khyad par can dang*/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas par yang dag mtha' mngon du mi byed pa'i thabs mkhas khyad par can dang ldan pa'i byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa rnam mkhyen la'ang gnyis las/ dang po ( rgyu mtshan dri ba ) ni/

'grel pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lags/'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka bcom ldan 'das rgyu mtshan ci'i slad du/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon rtogs bsdus pa lags/ shes dris pa'o//gnyis pa ( lan gyi sgo nas rgyu mtshan bkod pa ) ni/ 'grel pa/ rab 'byor rnam pa gang dag dang rtags gang dag dang mtshan ma gang dag gis chos rnams rab tu brjod pa'i rnam pa de dag dang rtags de dag dang mtshan ma de dag de bzhin gshegs pas thugs su chud de de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya'o//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka rab 'byor zhes bos nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mngon rtogs ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis bsdus shes bya ste/ rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir zhe na/ ngo bo'am rnam pa gang dag dang 'bras bu'am rtags gang dag dang rgyu'am mtshan ma gang dag gis chos rnams rab tu brjod pa'i rnam pa de dag dang rtags de dag dang mtshan ma de dag de bzhin gshegs pas sgrib bral du thugs su chud de rgyu mtshan de'i phyir ro//gnyis pa bsdus pa'i khungs dgod pa ni/ 'grel pa/ de bzhin du mdor bsdus pa las kyang nyan thos kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs la/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs bsdus tshul yum bar ma las gsungs pa de bzhin du mdor bsdus pa brgyad stong pa las kyang gsungs te/ de las/ nyan thos kyi sa la bslab par 'dod pas kyang sher phyin la bslab par bya'o/ /rang rgyal gyi sa la bslab par 'dod pas kyang de la bslab par bya'o/

/zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pas so//gsum pa rgyas pa'i khungs dgod pa ni/ 'grel pa/ rgyas pa las kyang rgya cher gsungs so// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka bsdus 'bring de bzhin du rgyas pa 'bum las kyang gsungs te/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i sa la bslab par 'dod pas kyang sher phyin la bslab par bya'o/ / zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pas so/ /bsdus rgyas gnyis kyi lung 'dis mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs bsdus par ji ltar bstan zhe na/ bstan te ma bsdus na 'phags pa de dang de'i spangs rtogs sgrub par 'dod pas mkhyen gsum la bslab pa don med du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro//gsum pa bsdu byed gsum ngos bzung ba ni/ 'grel pa/ de la thams cad shes pa nyid ni gzugs la sogs pa'i chos la mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i rten can 'bras bu bdag tu rmongs pa spangs pa can yin no//lam shes pa nyid ni theg pa thams cad kyis nges par 'byung ba dang*/ de kho na nyid mngon sum du mi byed pa'i rten can 'bras bu sems can ma bsdus pa sdud pa la sogs par byed pa can yin no//rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i rten can 'bras bu nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs par sems can gyi don rgyun mi chad pa dang*/ yang dag pa nyid kyi mtha' rtogs pa dang bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba nyid spangs pa can yin no// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka sras bzhi'i mngon rtogs bsdu byed mkhyen pa gsum du bstan pa de la bsdu byed kyi mkhyen pa gsum po de'ang gang zhe na/ bsdu byed kyi thams cad shes pa nyid ni chos can/ khyad par gsum dang ldan te/ dmigs pa'i khyad par gzugs la sogs pa'i phyi nang gi chos bden bzhis bsdus pa rnams la dmigs shing*/ rnam pa'i khyad par mi rtag pa la sogs bcu drug la brten pa'i yul can yin la/ bral ba'i 'bras bu'i khyad par phung po la bdag tu rmongs pa spangs pa can yin pas so//lam shes pa nyid ni chos can/

bsal ba sngar bzhin/ dmigs pa'i khyad par shes rab kyis theg pa gsum gyi rtogs ris thams cad kyi rang rang gi spang bya las nges par 'byung ba la dmigs pa dang*/ rnam pa'i khyad par rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas par de kho na nyid mngon sum du mi byed pa la brten pa'i yul can yin zhing*/ byed pa'i 'bras bu'i khyad par sems can 'khor du ma bsdus pa sdud pa dang la sogs pas bsdus pa smin smin pa grol grol ba mthar phyin par byed pa can yin pas so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni chos can/ khyad par gsum dang ldan te/ dmigs pa'i khyad par chos thams cad la dmigs nas/ rnam pa'i khyad par rang bzhin gyis skye ba med par rtogs pa'i rten can 'bras bu'i khyad par nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs par sems can gyi don rgyun mi chad par mdzad pa gzhan don dang*/ yang dag pa nyid kyi mtha' glo bur dri bral gyi chos sku rtogs pa phun tshogs dang ma rig pa'i bag chags dang zag med kyi las kyis yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus len pa'i mtshams sbyor ba nyid spangs pa ste spangs rtogs phun tshogs dang ldan pa can yin pas so//bzhi pa de dag gi don bsdu ba ni/ 'grel pa/ de lta bas na mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ni gzhi dang gnyen po rnam pa thams cad bsdus pas mngon par rtogs pa ril rdzogs par bstan pa yin no/ /zhes bya ba 'di 'thad pa yin no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka mkhyen gsum gyis sras bzhi'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa de lta bas na mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ni chos can/ mngon par rtogs pa phyogs re ba brjod byar bsdus pa ma yin par mngon rtogs ril rdzogs par brjod byar bstan pa yin no zhes bya ba 'di 'thad pa yin te/ yul gzhi dang gnyen po dang rnam pa ste de thams cad brjod byar bsdus pas so/ /khyab ste/ yul de gsum gyis yul can mkhyen gsum bsdus la/ mkhyen gsum gyis sras bzhi'i mngon rtogs mtha' dag bsdus par bstan pas so//gnyis pa brtsams pa'i bstan bcos la gzhan 'jug pa'i yan lag tu dgos 'brel bshad pa la gsum/

mtshams sbyar ba/ rtsa ba/ 'grel pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ skye bo blo gros dman pa dag /bcom ldan 'das rgyas pa dang 'bring dang mdor bsdus pa la dad pa'i sems can la phan 'dogs par bzhed pa thugs rje can nyid kyis rgyal ba'i yum de dang de las mngon par rtogs pa brgyad kyi rim pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don mtha' dag gsal bar mdzad pa ma yin nam/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa ma rgyal ba las rgyal bas yang de bstan pa la don ci zhig yod snyam du dogs pa bsal ba'i phyir/ don la the tshom bskyed pa nyid kyi 'jug pa'i yan lag rang gi bstan bcos kyi brjod par bya ba dang*/ dgos pa dang*/ dgos pa'i yang dgos pa dang*/ 'brel ba khong na yod pa rnams gsungs te/'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka de ltar mchod par brjod nas de'i 'og tu rje btsun byams pa rang gi bstan bcos kyi brjod par bya ba dang*/ dgos pa dang*/ dgos pa'i yang dgos pa nying dgos dang*/ 'brel ba rtsa tshig gi khong na yod pa rnams gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ mdo bstan bcos kyi dgos pa'i khyad par mi shes pa'i skye bo blo gros dman pa dag /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa ma rgyal ba bdud bzhi las rgyal ba'i byams pas rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rjes su yang mngon rtogs rgyan de bstan pa la don ci zhig yod de med par thal/ bcom ldan 'das rgyas pa dang 'bring dang mdor bsdus pa la dad pa'i sems can la phan 'dogs par bzhed pa'i thugs rje can shākya thub pa nyid kyis rgyal ba'i yum rgyas 'bring de dang bsdus pa de las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i brjod bya'i don mngon par rtogs pa brgyad kyi rim pa mtha' dag gsal bar mdzad zin pa ma yin nam ste yin pa'i phyir snyam du dogs pa'i log par rtog pa bsal ba'i phyir gdul bya rgyan la don 'gyur gyi the tshom bskyed pa nyid kyi sgo nas bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba'i ched yod pas so//gnyis pa

( rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam//ston pas 'di rnams bshad pa gang*//gzhan gyis myong ba ma yin te//chos spyod bcu yi bdag nyid kyi// 2 mdo don dran pa la bzhag nas//blo dang ldan pas mthong 'gyur phyir//bde blag tu ni rtogs pa zhes//bya ba rtsam pa'i dgos pa yin// 3 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka ston pas yum gsum po 'di las bshad pa gang yin pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis nye bar mtshon pa'i lam mngon par rtogs pa brgyad chos can/ rgyan gyi brjod bya yin te/ de'i bshad bya yin pas so/ /byang sems las gzhan gyis nyams su myong ba ma yin zhing*/ blo dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpas chos spyod bcu'i bdag nyid can gyi mdo'i don dran pa'i shes pa la bzhag nas mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ba'i rnam mkhyen de chos can/ de'i nying dgos yin te/ de'i dgos pa'i yang dgos pa yin pas so/ /nying dgos de thob pa'i phyir du bstan bcos la thos bsam byas pas mdo don bde blag tu ni rtogs pa zhes bya ba 'di chos can/ de rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin te/ de'i ched du bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ngag don/ rje btsun byams mgon chos can/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi dgos 'brel gsungs pa la dgos pa yod de/ don gnyer gyi gdul byas rgyan gyi dgos sogs bzhi la brten nas de la thos sogs kyis 'jug pa'i ched yod pas so//gsum pa

( 'grel pa ) la bzhi/ brjod bya/ 'brel ba/ nying dgos/ dgos pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam ste/ mngon par rtogs pa thams cad nye bar mtshon pa lhur len pa yin no//bcom ldan 'das cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum gyis 'gro ba mtha' dag la rjes su ston par mdzad pa de nyid kyis rgyal ba'i yum rnam pa gsum car las brjod par bya ba nyid du ston pa gang yin pa/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka bcom ldan 'das sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang*/ thugs kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul dang*/ gsung rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul te cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas gdul bya 'gro ba mtha' dag la mngon mtho nges legs kyi lam rjes su ston par mdzad pa de nyid kyis rgyal ba'i yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa rnam pa gsum car las brjod par bya ba nyid du bstan pa gang yin pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de ni sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam ste des nye bar mtshon pa lhur len pa'i mngon par rtogs pa brgyad po thams cad chos can/ rgyan gyi brjod bya yin te/ de'i bshad bya yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ( 'brel ba ) ni/ 'grel pa/ rjod par byed pa dang brjod par bya ba dag thabs dang thabs kyi bsgrub par bya ba'i tshul gyis 'brel bar mdzad pa/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka rjod par byed pa mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ brjod par bya ba mngon rtogs brgyad po dag dang thabs dang thabs kyis bsgrub par bya ba'i tshul gyis 'brel ba grub par mdzad pa ste/ khyod mngon rtoḍa brgyad sgrub byed kyi gzhung dang de khyod kyi bsgrub bya rnam dag yin pas so//gsum pa ( nying dgos ) ni/ 'grel pa/ phyi rol pa dang cig shos kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba la sogs pa chos thams cad bdag med pa la goms par ma byas pa rnams kyis thos pa las byung ba la sogs pa'i shes pa skye ba'i rim gyis ma myangs ba ste/

byang chub sems dpa' rang dang gzhan gyi don du phun sum tshogs pa sgrub pa ci la yang ma rag par chas pa dag kho nas nyams su myong ba shin tu gsal bas bzhag pa'i bag chags las byung ba'i dran pa'i shes pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i don ma lus pa mngon par rtogs pa brgyad kyi bdag nyid byang chub kyi sems dang sbyin pa la sogs pa sgrub pa'i spyod pa legs par bzhag nas/ chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'gro ba rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid sa rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa rtogs pa'i rim pas rnam pa thams cad mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ba zhes bya ba dgos pa'i yang*/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka 'phrog byed sogs phyi rol pa dang cig shos nang pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba nyan rang dgra bcom la sogs pa chos thams cad chos kyi bdag med pa la goms par ma byas pa rnams kyis thos pa dang bsam pa las byung ba la sogs pa'i shes pa skye ba'i rim gyis ma myangs pa mngon rtogs brgyad yongs su rdzogs pa de byang chub sems dpa' rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub pa'i thabs rang gis phyin ci ma log par shes pas gzhan ci la yang ma rag par theg chen gyi lam du chas pa dag kho nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes pas nyams su myong ba shin tu gsal bas bzhag pa'i bag chags las byung ba'i dran pa'i shes pa la/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi mdo'i don ma lus pa mngon par rtogs pa brgyad kyi bdag nyid byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang*/ sbyin pa la sogs pa sgrub pa la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi brjod bya chos spyod bcu sgrub pa'i spyod pa legs par bzhag nas nyams su blangs pas chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'gro ba rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi sa rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa sa bcu rtogs pa'i rim pas rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i tshul gyis 'bras bu mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ba zhes bya ba chos can/

bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan gyi nying dgos yin te/ de'i dgos pa'i dgos pa yin pas so//bzhi pa ( dgos pa bshad pa ) ni/ 'grel pa/ dgos pa'i yang ched du mngon par 'dod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don byang chub kyi sems dang sgrub pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid gdul bya rnams kyis bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur ba ni bstan bcos rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka nying dgos de thob pa'i ched du byang chub sems dpas mngon par 'dod pa'i bdag nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i don rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos byang chub kyi sems bskyed dang sgrub pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid kyis nye bar mtshon pa dngos brgyad don bdun cu dang bcas pa gdul bya rnams kyis bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur ba ni chos can/ bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin te/ de'i ched du bya ba yin pas so//gsum pa 'jug bya bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs nyid bshad pa la gsum/ rgyas pa la dad pa'i gang zag la don brgyad du phye ste bshad pa/ bar ma la dad pa'i gang zag la don drug tu bstan pa/ bsdus pa la dad pa'i gang zag la don gsum du bsdus te bstan pa'o//dang po la gnyis/ lus rnam par gzhag pa dang*/ yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum/ mtshams sbyar/ rtsa ba/ 'grel pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ de ltar 'brel ba la sogs pa bsnyad nas/ gdul bya rnams kyis bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir dang bstan bcos kyi don rnam par dbye ba byas pa yang ma 'dzings pa nyid kyis bshad par bya sla bar gzigs nas tshig le'ur byas pa bco lngas mdo dang rgyas par bstan pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i lus rnam par gzhag pa gsungs te/'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka de ltar 'brel ba dang dgos pa la sogs pa bsnyad nas de'i 'og tu tshig le'ur byas pa bco lnga'i tshigs bcad dang po gnyis kyis mdor bstan pa dang*/

lhag ma rnams kyis rgyas par bstan pa'i tshul gyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i lus rnam par gzhag pa gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ gdul bya nyan pa po rnams kyis tshig nyung ngus bstan bcos kyi don phal cher bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ 'chad pa po rnams kyis bstan bcos kyi don rnam par dbye ba byas pa yang lus dang mthun par go rim ma 'dzings pa nyid kyis bshad par bya sla ba'i dgos pa gnyis gzigs pa la brten nas so//gnyis pa ( rtsa ba ) la gsum/ mdor bstan pa/ cung zad bshad pa/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa ba/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni//dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad//rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka byams mgon chos can/ gzhung shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i lus rnam gzhag ni yang dag par bshad de/ de'i sbas don dngos po brgyad kyi sgo nas phyin ci ma log par bshad pas so//ngag don/ de chos can/ sher phyin yang dag par bshad de/ de dngos brgyad kyi sgo nas phyin ci ma log par bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ( cung zad bshad pa ) ni/ rtsa ba/ rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid//de nas thams cad shes pa nyid// 4 rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa dang*//rtse mor phyin dang mthar gyis pa//skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang chub//chos kyi sku dang de rnam brgyad// 5 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka dngos po brgyad po de'ang gang zhe na/ rgyan gyi brjod bya de yang chos can/ dbye na dngos po rnam pa brgyad yod de/ rnam pa kun mkhyen pa nyid dang*/ lam shes pa nyid dang*/ lam shes kyi rjes de nas bshad pa'i thams cad shes pa nyid dang*/ rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ rtse mor phyin pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ dus skad cig ma gcig la mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku dang brgyad yod pas so//gsum pa

( rgyas par bshad pa ) la gsum/ mkhyen gsum gyi lus rgyas bshad/ sbyor bzhi'i lus rgyas bshad/ chos sku'i lus rgyas bshad do/ /dang po la gsum/ rnam mkhyen gyi/ lam shes kyi/ gzhi shes kyi lus bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa ba/ sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang*//nges 'byed yan lag rnam bzhi dang*//sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa//chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang*// 6 dmigs pa dag dang ched dang ni//go cha 'jug pa'i bya ba dang*//tshogs ni nges par 'byung bcas rnams//thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid// 7 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka rten gyi gang zag thub pa sangs rgyas rnams dang 'brel ba rnam pa kun mkhyen pa nyid mtshon byed kyi chos chos can/ bcu yod de/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ theg chen gyi gdams ngag dang*/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag rnam pa bzhi dang*/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa yi ni rten du gyur ba chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs dang*/ theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa dag dang*/ de'i ched du bya ba dang ni/ go cha'i sgrub pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i bya ba'i sgrub pa dang*/ tshogs kyi sgrub pa dang ni/ nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa dang bcas pa rnams su yod pas so//gnyis pa ( lam shes kyi lus bshad pa ) ni/ rtsa ba/ mog mog por byed la sogs dang*//slob ma bse ru'i lam gang dang*//'di dang gzhan pa'i yon tan gyis//phan yon che ba mthong ba'i lam// 8 byed pa dang ni mos pa dang*//bstod dang bkur dang bsngags pa dang*//bsngo dang rjes su yi rang ba//yid la byed pa bla med dag/ 9 sgrub dang shin tu dag pa zhes//bya ba 'di ni sgom pa'i lam//byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyi//lam shes nyid ni de 'drar bshad// 10 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka rten gyi gang zag byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa rnams kyi rgyud dang 'brel ba lam shes pa nyid mtshon byed kyi chos ni chos can/ dbye na bcu gcig po de 'dra bar bshad de/

rnam smin las skyes pa'i lha'i 'od mog mog por byed pas bstan pa la sogs pa lam shes kyi yan lag dang*/ slob ma nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes gang yin pa dang*/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes gang yin pa dang*/ tshe 'di dang tshe rabs gzhan pa'i yon tan gyi phan yon che ba theg chen gyi mthong ba'i lam dang*/ sgom lam gyi byed pa dang ni/ mos pa sgom lam dang*/ mos pa la bstod pa dang bkur ba dang*/ bsngags pa thob pa'i phan yon dang*/ sngo ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam dang*/ rjes su yi rang ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam dag dang*/ sgrub pa sgom lam dang*/ shin tu rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba sgom pa'i lam ste bcu gcig po 'di ni de mtshon byed kyi chos yin pas so//gsum pa ( gzhi shes kyi lus bshad pa ) ni/ rtsa ba/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*//snying rjes zhi la mi gnas dang*//thabs ma yin pas ring ba dang*//thabs kyis ring ba ma yin nyid// 11 mi mthun gnyen po'i phyogs dag dang*//sbyor dang de yi mnyam nyid dang*//nyan thos la sogs mthong ba'i lam//de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod// 12 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka rten gyi gang zag nyan thos la sogs dang 'brel ba gzhi kun shes pa nyid mtshon byed kyi chos chos can/ dbye na dgu po de 'dra bar 'dod de/ gnas lugs shes pas srid pa 'khor ba la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes dang*/ snying rje chen pos zhi ba myang 'das la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes dang*/ 'bras yum sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa ma yin pas 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes dang*/ de sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas pa nyid kyis de la ring ba ma yin pa'i gzhi shes nyid dang*/ theg chen lam gyi mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang*/ de'i gnyen po'i phyogs kyi gzhi shes dag dang*/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba dang*/ sbyor ba de'i mnyam pa nyid dang*/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes kyi mthong ba'i lam rnams su yod pas so//gnyis pa sbyor bzhi'i lus rgyas bshad la bzhi/

rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i/ rtse sbyor gyi/ mthar gyis sbyor ba'i/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i lus rgyas bshad do/ /dang po ni/ rtsa ba/ rnam pa sbyor bar bcas rnams dang*//yon tan skyon ni mtshan nyid bcas//thar dang nges 'byed cha mthun dang*//slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs// 13 srid dang zhi ba mnyam nyid dang*//zhing dag bla na med pa ni//rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa ste//'di ni thabs mkhas bcas pa yin// 14 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos 'di ni chos can/ dbye na bcu gcig yod de/ bsgom bya rnam pa rnams dang*/ sgom byed kyi sbyor ba gang zag dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ theg chen sbyor ba'i yon tan dang*/ de'i skyon dang ni/ theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid mtshan dang bcas pa dang*/ theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun dang*/ de'i nges 'byed cha mthun dang*/ slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang*/ srid pa dang zhi ba mnyam nyid du rtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ zhing dag pa bla na med pa'i sbyor ba dang ni/ thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba dang bcas pa rnams su yod pa yin pas so//gnyis pa ( rtse sbyor gyi lus rgyas bshad ) ni/ rtsa ba/ de yi rtags dang rnam 'phel dang*//brtan dang sems kun gnas pa dang*//mthong zhes bya dang sgom pa zhes//bya ba'i lam ni so so la// 15rnam par rtog pa rnam bzhi yi//gnyen po rnam pa bzhi dang ni//bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin//log par sgrub dang bcas pa ni// 16 rtse mo'i mngon rtogs rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka rtse mo'i mngon par rtogs pa'i sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos ni chos can/ dbye na brgyad yod de/ rtse sbyor de'i rtags dang*/ rnam 'phel rtse sbyor dang*/ brtan pa rtse sbyor dang*/ sems kun tu gnas pa'i rtse sbyor dang*/ mthong ba zhes bya ba'i lam ni so so la spang bya rnam par rtog pa rnam pa bzhi'i gnyen po rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa mthong lam rtse sbyor dang ni/

sgom pa zhes bya ba'i lam ni so so la spang bya rnam par rtog pa rnam pa bzhi'i gnyen po rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa sgom lam rtse sbyor dang*/ bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rtse sbyor dang*/ bsal bya log par sgrub pa dang bcas pa rnams su yod pas so//gsum pa ( mthar gyis sbyor ba'i lus rgyas bshad ) ni/ rtsa ba/ mthar gyis pa//rnam gsum rnam bcu rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos chos can/ bcu gsum yod de/ phar phyin drug nyams len gyi mthar gyis pa drug /rjes dran drug nyams len gyi de drug /dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i mthar gyis pa ste sdoms na rnam pa bcu dang rnam pa gsum rnams su yod pas so//bzhi pa ( skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i lus rgyas bshad ) ni/ rtsa ba/ skad cig ma//gcig gis mngon rdzogs byang chub pa//mtshan nyid kyis ni rnam pa bzhi// 17rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka skad cig ma gcig gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa mtshon byed kyi chos chos can/ dbye na ngo bo tha mi dad kyang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis ni phye ba rnam pa bzhi yod de/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa dang*/ rnam par smin pa dang*/ mtshan nyid med pa dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig sbyor rnams su yod pas so//gsum pa chos sku'i lus rgyas bshad ni/ rtsa ba/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang*//de bzhin gzhan pa sprul pa ni//chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa//rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod// 18 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka 'bras bu chos kyi sku mtshon byed kyi chos chos can/ dbye na rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag par brjod de/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mtshan dpe dang bcas pa dang*/ de bzhin du longs sku las gzhan pa sprul ba'i sku dang ni/ rtogs pa chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa rnams su yod pas so//gsum pa 'grel pa la gnyis/

mdor bsdus te bkrol ba dang*/ rgyas par ma bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ de la tshig le'ur byas pa dang po gnyis kyis ni dngos po brgyad bsdus pa'i phyir mdor bstan pa yin no/ /tshig le'ur byas pa bcu gsum gyis ni de dag nyid kyi don bsdus nas rgyas par bshad do/ /de ltar na bsdus pa dang rgyas par bshad pa'i phyir legs par bshad pa yin no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka tshigs bcad bco lnga yod pa de la/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /zhes sogs tshig le'ur byas pa dang po gnyis kyis ni chos can/ yum gyi lus mdor bstan pa yin te/ de dngos po brgyad du bsdus nas bstan pa'i phyir/ sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang*/ /zhes sogs tshig le'ur byas pa bcu gsum gyis ni chos can/ lus mdor bstan de nyid cung zad rgyas par bshad pa yin te/ tshigs bcad snga ma gnyis po de dag nyid kyi don don bdun cu'i grangs tsam du bsdus nas cung zad phye ste bshad pas so/ /tshul de ltar na lus rnam gzhag gi tshigs su bcad pa bco lnga chos can/ yum gyi lus legs par bshad pa yin te/ mdor bsdus pa dang rgyas par bshad pa gnyis kyi sgo nas bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa

( rgyas par ma bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan ) ni/ 'grel pa/ bsdus pa'i don gyi tshig le'ur byas pa rnams ni/ bstan bcos mdzad pa nyid kyis/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir//zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos mtha' dag gis 'chad pas/ de dag rnam par bshad pas bshad par bsams te/ zlos pa'i nyes par 'gyur du dogs nas rnam par ma bkrol lo//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka slob dpon seng ge bzang po chos can/ bsdus pa'i don gyi tshig le'ur byas pa lus rnam gzhag gi tshigs bcad bco lnga po rnams ni yan lag rgyas bshad kyi gong 'dir rnam par ma bkrol te/ bstan bcos mdzad pa po byams pa nyid kyis sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir zhes bya ba la sogs pa yan lag rgyas bshad du 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos mtha' dag gis rim pa ltar 'chad pas rgyas bshad de dag rnam par bshad pas bsdus don rnams kyang bshad par 'gyur bar bsams shing 'dir bshad na 'chad 'gyur dang zlos pa'i nyes par yang 'gyur du dogs nas so//gnyis pa yan lag rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ yul mkhyen gsum/ thabs sbyor bzhi/ 'bras bu chos sku bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ thob bya rnam mkhyen/ lam gyi gzhi lam shes/ lam gyi yan lag gol sa dang bcas pa'i gzhi shes bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ 'brel bkod pas mtshams sbyar ba/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad pa/ skabs kyi grangs brjod pas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ de ltar bsdus pa'i don kun bstan nas/ byang chub sems dpa' byang chub rjes su 'thob par 'dod pas 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par bya dgos pas/ dang por rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de sdud pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa rnam par bshad pa'i sgo nas bshad par bshad de/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka gong du bshad pa de ltar bsdus pa'i don lus rnam gzhag kun bstan nas skabs brgyad kyi dang por rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de sdud pa'i lus kyi tshig le'ur byas pa gnyis po de'i don rnam par te rgyas par bshad pa'i sgo nas yan lag rgyas bshad kyi tshul du bshad par bzhed de/

rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de ni byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa'i byang chub rjes su thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis don du gnyer bya'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir na dang por thob par bya dgos pa nyid kyis so//ngag don/ rje btsun byams mgon chos can/ skabs brgyad kyi dang por rnam mkhyen 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam mkhyen de byang sems kyi thob bya mthar thug yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ( mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad pa ) la bdun/ sems bskyed/ gdams ngag /nges 'byed sbyor lam/ sgrub pa'i rten/ sgrub pa'i dmigs pa/ sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba/ sgrub pa'i ngo bo'o/ /dang po la gsum/ sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid/ dmigs yul/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ spyi'i mtshams sbyar ba/ rtsa ba/ 'grel pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ sems skyed pa rang gi ngo bo dmigs pa dang bcas pa/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka byams mgon chos can/ rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu'i nang nas dang por theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed pa rang gi ngo bo dang dmigs pa dang dbye ba sa mtshams dang bcas pa 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sems bskyed de rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu'i gtso bo yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so// gnyis pa ( rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir//yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod//rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'dun ldan sems bskyed ni mtshan gzhi/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed pa yin par mtshon/ dmigs yul gzhan gyi don gyi phyir du don du gnyer bya yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i 'dod pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems khyad par can yin pa'o//ngag don/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi gzhan don du rdzogs byang don gnyer gyi 'dun pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems khyad par can chos can/

theg chen sems bskyed yin te/ gzhan don du rdzogs byang la dmigs pa'i sems khyad par can yin pas so//gsum pa ( 'grel pa ) la gnyis/ tshig don dang*/ rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ sangs rgyas su grub nas gzhan gyi don gyi phyir skal ba ji lta bzhin du 'bad par bya'o zhes sems bskyed pa gzhan gyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'i mtshan nyid smon pa dang 'jug pa'i ngo bo nyid rnam pa gnyis so//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka thog mar rang nyid sangs rgyas su grub nas sems can gzhan gyi don gyi phyir du gdul bya'i skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du de'i don bsgrub pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /zhes sems bskyed pa gzhan gyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed pa ni chos can/ dbye na gnyis yod de/ smon pa sems bskyed kyi ngo bo nyid du gyur pa dang 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi ngo bo nyid du gyur pa rnam pa gnyis yod pas so//ngag don/ 'dir bstan theg chen sems bskyed chos can/ dbye na gnyis yod de/ smon 'jug gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ( rtsod pa spang ba ) la gnyis/ rtsod pa dang*/ lan no/ /dang po la/ gang la/ gang gis/ ji ltar rtsod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod//ces pa'i don ma rtogs par sgra ji bzhin pa la'o//gnyis pa ni/ sems bskyed dang sems byung 'gal bar smra ba'i phyogs la brten pa dag gis so//gsum pa ( ji ltar rtsod pa ) ni/ 'grel pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa nyid ni/ de don du gnyer ba dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa sems las byung ba yin la/ sems bskyed pa ni sems yul khyad par du 'phags pa snang ba can 'byung ba ma yin nam/ ji ltar na de sems bskyed pa yin par 'gyur zhe na/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa nyid ni chos can/

rgyu mtshan ji ltar na de sems bskyed pa yin par 'gyur te ma yin par thal/ sems las byung ba yin pas so/ /khyab ste/ 'dod pa de ni byang chub de don du gnyer ba dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa yul nges lnga'i nang tshan yin la/ sems bskyed pa de ni grogs sems pa dang mtshungs ldan du byung ba'i sems yul khyad par du 'phags pa don gnyis snang ba can du 'byung ba ma yin nam ste yin pas so zhes zer na/ gnyis pa lan la gnyis/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ so sor bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ bden mod kyi/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka sems byung yin na sems bskyed ma yin pa bden mod kyi/ 'on kyang*/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /zhes sogs kyi gzhung 'dir ni 'dod pa sems bskyed du bshad pa'i nyes pa med de/ 'dod pa'i ming gis don sems bskyed la nye bar btags pa la brten nas bstan pa yin pas so/ /'dogs pa'i chos gsum ni phyi ma gnyis dang 'dra'o//gnyis pa ( so sor bshad pa ) la gnyis/ rgyu ming 'bras bu la dang*/ grogs ming grogs can la btags pa'i lan no/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ 'on kyang 'dir dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa'-i mtshan nyid don du gnyer ba yod na byang chub kyi sems bskyed pas rgyus 'bras bu bstan pa yin te/ de ltar don du gnyer ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i chos thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir/ nye bar btags pa la brten pa yin pas nyes pa med do//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka shes bya chos can/ skabs 'dir rgyu 'dod pa'i ming gis 'bras bu sems bskyed la btags nas yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod ces bstan pa yin te/ de ltar 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i phyir/ 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dge ba'i chos gzhan don la 'dun pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi gzhan don don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa de yod na byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis so//btags pa la dgos pa yod de/

de ltar gzhan don don du gnyer ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud la theg chen gyi dge ba'i chos thams cad rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhes shes par bya ba'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ dngos la gnod byed yod de/ sems byung yin na de ma yin dgos pa la bden lan byin pas so//gnyis pa ( grogs ming grogs can la btags pa'i lan ) ni/ 'grel pa/ rnam pa gcig tu na smon lam ni don du gnyer ba ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa nyid yin la/ de dang lhan cig spyod pa'i sems bskyed pa de'i sgrar bstan pa ni de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams la smon lam dang ldan pa'i sems de skye'o zhes bya bar shes par bya ba'i phyir yin no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka lan gyi rnam pa gcig tu na/ 'dod ces pa'i gzhung chos can/ grogs can sems bskyed pa la grogs smon lam de'i sgrar btags nas bstan pa yin te/ rtags sngar bzhin/ der 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gzhan don du byang chub la smon pa'i smon lam ni byang chub don du gnyer ba ste de yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod cing don du gnyer ba nyid yin la grogs can theg chen sems bskyed ni rang gi grogs de dang lhan cig tu spyod cing mtshungs ldan rnam pa lngas mtshungs pas so//de ltar btags pa la dgos pa yod de/ rgyu mtshan de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams la byang chub don gnyer gyi smon lam dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems bskyed de skye'o zhes bya bar shes par bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ dngos la gnod byed gong bzhin/ gnyis pa dmigs yul la/ sbyar/ rtsa/ 'grel gsum las/ dang po ( mtshams sbyar ) ni/ 'grel pa/ yang gang 'dod pa'i bdag nyid dang*/ gang gi don du sems bskyed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub de ni gang yin gzhan gyi don ni gang yin zhe na/'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka de dang de ni zhes sogs gsungs pa chos can/

dgos pa yod de/ ngo bo la dri bar ma zad slar yang gang 'dod pa'i bdag nyid dmigs yul yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub de ni gang yin/ ched du bya ba gang gi don du sems bskyed pa gzhan gyi don ni gang yin zhes dri na de'i lan btab pa'i ched yod pas so// gnyis pa ( rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ de dang de ni mdo bzhin du//bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod// 19 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka rje btsun byams mgon chos can/ sems bskyed kyi dmigs yul rdzogs byang de dang ched du bya ba gzhan don de ni yang dag par brjod de/ de gnyis ni yum gyi mdo ji lta ba bzhin du bsdus pa dang rgyas pa gnyis kyi sgo nas phyin ci ma log par brjod pas so//gsum pa ( 'grel pa ) la gsum/ rtsa ba'i tshig don bshad pa/ don bsdu ba/ gzhan gyi mdo mi 'dren pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po la gnyis/ mdo nas bstan tshul dang*/ tshig don dngos so/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ rgyal ba'i yum rnam pa gsum car las kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang sbyin pa la sogs pa thams cad la sbyin par bya ba dang*/ sbyin pa po dang*/ len pa po la sogs pa mi dmigs par bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes shes par byed pa'i don can dang*/ sems can thams cad skal pa ji lta ba bzhin du mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ ser sna can la sogs pa rnams sbyin pa la sogs pa la dgod par 'dod pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka byang chub dang gzhan don mdo bzhin du rgyas bsdus gnyis kyi sgo nas brjod na/ mdo gang las gsungs she na/ rgyal ba'i yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa rnam pa gsum car las kyang gsungs so/ /ji ltar zhe na brgyad stong pa las ni/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las brtsams te spobs par gyis shig

/ces pa 'dis bstan te/ yum gzhan gnyis kyi don brgyad stong par tshang la/ ston byed gzhan med pa'i phyir te/ brgyad stong don bsdus las/ brgyad stong 'dir don ma tshang med/ /ces gsungs pas so//gzhan gnyis las ni/ bstan bshad gnyis gnyis kyis gsungs te/ ji skad du/ shā ri'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad duu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i mdo chos can/ byang chub mdor bstan te/ byang chub kyi ming tsam bstan pas so//shā ri'i bu 'di la byang chen mi gnas pa'i tshul gyis sher phyin la gnas te sbyin pa la sogs pa thams cad la sbyin par bya ba dang*/ sbyin pa po dang len pa po la sogs pa mi dmigs pa'i phyir yongs su btang pa med pa'i tshul gyis sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa shes par byed pa'i don can gyi mdo chos can/ byang chub rgyas par bshad de/ byang chub kyi ngo bo phyin drug tu phye ste bshad pas so//'dir bsgrub par bya'o zhes dang*/ mdor rdzogs par bya'o zhes 'byung ba ni 'gyur gyi khyad par ro/ /byang chen phyogs bcu re re zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na sems can gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad skal pa ji lta ba bzhin du phung po lhag ma med pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod pas sher phyin la bslab par bya'o zhes sogs kyi mdo chos can/ gzhan don mdor bstan te/ gzhan don bya tshul bsdus te bstan pas so//'grel par drangs pa ni slob dpon gyis tshig sna bsdus pa'o/ /sems can ser sna can la sogs pa rnams sbyin pa la sogs pa la dgod par 'dod pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bsgrub par bya'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i mdo chos can/

gzhan don rgyas par bstan te/ gzhan don bya tshul phye nas bstan pas so//gnyis pa ( tshig don dngos ) ni/ 'grel pa/ rab tu ston pa lhur byed pa'i ngag gis mdo'i don dang mi 'gal bar bsdus pa dang*/ rgyas pa'i sgo nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang*/ gzhan gyi don bstan te/'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka gzhan don dang byang chub rab tu ston pa'i mdo'i don brjod byar lhur len par byed pa'i ngag mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ khyod kyis sems bskyed kyi dmigs yul yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang ched du bya ba gzhan gyi don ni ji lta ba bzhin bstan te/ de ni sher phyin gyi mdo'i don dang mi 'gal bar bsdus pa dang rgyas pa gnyis kyi sgo nas phyin ci ma log par bstan pas so//gnyis pa don bsdu ba ni/ 'grel pa/ de ltar na sems bskyed pa ni gzhan gyi don gyi phyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'i bdag nyid yin par shes par bya'o//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed pa ni chos can/ ched du bya ba gzhan gyi don gyi phyir du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs nas de 'dod pa'i bdag nyid can yin par shes par bya ste/ yum gyi mdo las gzhan don du byang chub la dmigs par gsungs pa de ltar na'o//gsum pa gzhan gyi mdo mi 'dren pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'grel pa/ gtsug lag gi gzhung skabs kyi don ston pa lhur len pa ni thams cad las kyang gsungs mod kyi tshig mangs su dogs nas khungs nyid du ma bris so//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka sems bskyed la yum gsum gyi mdo khungs su brjod pa ltar/ gdams ngag sogs lhag ma thams cad la yang khungs su brjod par mdzad dam zhe na/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po chos can/ gtsug lag gi gzhung yum gyi mdo las don bdun cu po so so'i skabs kyi don ston pa lhur len pa ni sems bskyed du ma zad gzhan thams cad las kyang gsungs mod kyi gdams ngag nas sprul sku'i bar la mdo tshig khungs nyid du ma bris te/
'grel pa don gsal tshig mangs su dogs nas so//gsum pa dbye ba la/ sbyar/ rtsa/ 'grel gsum las/ dang po

( mtshams sbyar ) ni/ 'grel pa/ de ltar sems bskyed pa dmigs pa dang rang gi ngo bo dang bcas pa brjod nas/ da ni de'i rab tu dbye ba rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka de ltar na sems bskyed pa rang gi ngo bo dmigs pa dang bcas pa brjod nas/ da ni sems bskyed de'i rab tu dbye ba rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyis gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ sems bskyed kyi dbye ba bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yod pas so//gnyis pa ( rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ de yang sa gser zla ba me//gter dang rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho//rdo rje ri sman bshes gnyen dang*//yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma glu// 20 rgyal po mdzod dang lam po che//bzhon pa bkod ma'i chu dang ni//sgra brnyan chu bo sprin rnams kyis//rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// 21 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka theg chen sems bskyed de'ang chos can/ dbye na rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod de/ sa lta bu'i sems bskyed dang*/ gser bzang po lta bu dang*/ zla ba lta bu dang*/ me lta bu dang*/ gter lta bu dang*/ rin po che'i 'byung khungs kyi gnas lta bu dang*/ rgya mtsho lta bu dang*/ rdo rje lta bu dang*/ ri lta bu dang*/ sman lta bu dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bu dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu dang*/ nyi ma lta bu dang*/ glu dbyangs lta bu dang*/ rgyal po lta bu dang*/ bang mdzod lta bu dang*/ lam po che lta bu dang*/ bzhon pa bzang po lta bu dang*/ bkod ma'i chu lta bu dang ni/ sgra snyan pa lta bu dang*/ chu bo'i rgyun lta bu dang*/ sprin lta bu'i sems bskyed rnams su yod pas so/ /ngag don/ theg chen sems bskyed chos can/ khyod la dbye na nyer gnyis yod de/ sa lta bu'i sems bskyed nas sprin lta bu'i sems bskyed kyi bar du dbyer yod pas so//gsum pa ( 'grel pa ) la gsum/

dpe grogs chos mthun gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa/ de'i don bsdu ba/ sa mtshams so/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ zhes bya ba dag gis bshad de/ 'dun pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ lhag pa'i bsam pa dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ sbyin pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ bzod pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ shes rab dang*/ thabs mkhas pa dang*/ smon lam dang*/ stobs dang*/ ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ mngon par shes pa dang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos dang*/ snying rje dang lhag mthong dang*/ gzungs dang spobs pa dang*/ chos kyi dga' ston dang*/ bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam dang*/ chos kyi sku dang ldan pa ni/ ༈ go rim bzhin du sa dang*/ gser bzang po dang*/ zla ba tshes pa dang*/ me dang*/ gter chen po dang*/ rin po che'i 'byung khungs kyi gnas dang*/ rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ ri'i rgyal po dang*/ sman dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ chos kyi sgra dbyangs snyan pa dang*/ rgyal po chen po dang*/ bang mdzod dang*/ lam po che dang*/ bzhon pa dang*/ bkod ma'i chu dang*/ sgra snyan pa dang*/ chu bo'i rgyun dang*/ sprin lta bu ste/ ༈ chos dkar po thams cad kyi gzhi'i dngos po dang*/ byang chub kyi bar du mi 'gyur ba dang*/ dge ba'i chos mtha' dag rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis sgrib pa'i bud shing sreg pa dang*/ sems can thams cad tshim par byed pa dang*/ yon tan rin po che'i rten gyi dngos po dang*/ mi 'dod pa thams cad thog tu babs pas mi 'khrugs pa dang*/ yid ches pa brtan pas mi phyed pa dang*/ dmigs pa'i rnam par g.yeng bas mi bskyod pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa'i nad rab tu zhi ba dang*/ gnas skabs thams cad du sems can gyi don yongs su mi gtong ba dang*/ ji ltar smon pa'i 'bras bu 'grub pa dang*/

gdul bya yongs su smin par byed pa dang*/ gdul bya 'dun par byed pa'i chos ston pa dang*/ mthu thogs pa med pas gzhan gyi don sgrub pa dang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs mang po'i mdzod lta bu dang*/ 'phags pa thams cad gshegs shing rjes su gshegs pa dang*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gang du yang mi ltung ba'i bde blag tu 'gro ba dang*/ thos pa dang ma thos pa'i chos 'dzin pas mi zad pa dang*/ thar pa 'dod pas gdul bya la snyan par sgrogs pa dang*/ gzhan gyi don bya ba tha mi dad pa dang*/ dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa la sogs pa kun tu ston pa rung ba nyid kyis grangs bzhin no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka de yang sa gser zhes pa nas rtsa gnyis so zhes bya ba'i bar dag gis sems bskyed kyi dbye ba bshad la/ de yang dpe grogs chos mthun gsum go rim bzhin du sbyar nas grogs chos can dang*/ dpe dam bca' dang*/ chos mthun gtan tshigs su grangs bzhin duu bkod na/ grogs byang chub don gnyer gyi 'dun pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni chos can/ sa lta bu yin te/ chos dkar po thams cad kyi bskyed pa'i gzhi'i dngos po byed pa nyid kyi phyir/ phan bde'i bsam pa dang ldan pa ni chos can/ gser bzang po lta bu ste/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du ngo bo mi 'gyur bas so/ /dran nye sgom 'dod kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa ni chos can/ zla ba tshes pa lta bu ste/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sogs dge ba'i chos mtha' dag gong nas gong du rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur bas so/ /mkhyen gsum sgom pa'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa ni chos can/ me lta bu ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa'i sgrib pa'i bud shing sreg par byed pas so/ /sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi nyams len dang ldan pa ni chos can/ gter chen po lta bu ste/ longs spyod kyi sgo nas sems can thams cad tshim par byed pas so/

/tshul khrims dang ldan pa ni chos can/ rin po che'i 'byung khungs kyi gnas lta bu ste/ yon tan rin po che rnams gang la brten pa'i rten gyi dngos po yin pas so/ /bzod pa dang ldan pa ni chos can/ rgya mtsho chen po lta bu ste/ mi 'dod pa thams cad thog tu bab pas rgyud mi 'khrugs pas so/ /brtson 'grus dang ldan pa ni chos can/ rdo rje lta bu ste/ las 'bras la yid ches pa brtan pas bdud las kyis mi phyed pas so/ /bsam gtan dang ldan pa ni chos can/ ri'i rgyal po lta bu ste/ dmigs pa'i rnam par g.yeng pas mi bskyod pas so/ /sher phyin dang ldan pa ni chos can/ sman lta bu ste/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pas bskyed pa'i rnam smin gyi nad rab tu zhi bar byed pas so/ /thabs la mkhas pa dang ldan pa ni chos can/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bu ste/ 'khor 'das kyi gnas skabs thams cad du sems can gyi don byed pa yongs su mi gtong bas so/ /smon lam dang ldan pa ni chos can/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu ste/ ji ltar smon lam btab pa'i 'bras bu thams cad bde blag tu 'grub pas so/ /stobs dang ldan pa ni chos can/ nyi ma lta bu ste/ skal pa dang 'tsham par gdul bya rnams yongs su smin par byed pas so/ /ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyams len dang ldan pa ni chos can/ chos kyi sgra dbyangs snyan pa lta bu ste/ gdul bya gus pas 'dun zhing dga' bar byed pa'i chos ston pas so/ /mngon par shes pa drug gi nyams len dang ldan pa ni chos can/ rgyal po chen po lta bu ste/ gzhan don byed pa'i mthu thogs pa med pa thob pas gdul bya gzhan gyi don rgya chen po sgrub pas so/ /bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dang ldan pa ni chos can/ bang mdzod lta bu ste/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs zad mi shes pa mang po'i mdzod lta bu yin pas so/ /byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos rnams dang ldan pa ni chos can/
